value.rationale: The complete rational orbifold Hodge–Deligne polynomial is a natural exact graded invariant of a newly constructed non-symplectic log-Enriques fourfold quotient. It records missing holomorphic top forms, nontrivial Hodge dimensions, and fractional Hodge grading of two geometrically distinct sectors, information not fixed by its previously known Euler numbers. Its computation requires object-specific residue character and fixed-stratum analysis; no large downstream theorem is claimed.
